response.sql: WITH telescope_counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) as telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), all_stations AS (SELECT observstation FROM observatories), stations_with_counts AS (SELECT s.observstation, COALESCE(tc.telescope_count, 0) as telescope_count FROM all_stations s LEFT JOIN telescope_counts tc ON s.observstation = tc.observstation), total_count AS (SELECT SUM(telescope_count) as total FROM stations_with_counts) SELECT swc.observstation, swc.telescope_count, CAST(swc.telescope_count AS REAL) / t.total AS share FROM stations_with_counts swc CROSS JOIN total_count t ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: All observatory stations from the observatories table are considered, including those with zero telescopes (they have telescope_count = 0 and share = 0.0).

alternatives.interpretation: Only consider observatory stations that have at least one telescope (distinct observstation values in the telescopes table), excluding stations with zero telescopes.
